name: South Seas
summary: Merchant ships and pirate crews contend across the South Seas, between southern Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms. Tanaris and Stranglethorn Vale border these tropical waters, where reefs and other dangers threaten every voyage.

sections.title: A Swashbuckler's Frontier
sections.body:
The South Seas stretch south from the Great Sea and the Maelstrom, washing against Tanaris and Stranglethorn Vale. The Great Sundering shattered the primeval continent ten thousand years ago, leaving remote tropical islands and waters rich with ocean life.

Independent merchant networks cross these seas. Goblin shipping cartels work from havens such as Steamwheedle Port and Booty Bay to keep the lanes open. Corsairs and Bloodsail buccaneers prey on passing ships, while dangerous sea life threatens vessels far from shore.

sections.title: Hidden Depths and Distant Isles
sections.body: Beyond the coastal trade lanes lie legendary islands and dangers beneath the waves. Zandalar, the ancient troll island, and the produce-rich shores of Tel'Abim are scattered across the South Seas. Cutthroats are not the only danger: giant squids, primeval sea turtles, and naga haunt the deeper waters. The naga guard ancient ruins swallowed by the waves. Captains need experience, reliable charts, and substantial firepower to cross these seas.

faq.q: What zones border the South Seas?
faq.answer: In southern Kalimdor, the South Seas meet Tanaris near Uldum's sealed gates. To the east, they wash against Stranglethorn Vale and nearby islands such as Jaguero Isle and Yojamba Isle.

faq.q: Who controls shipping in the South Seas?
faq.answer: No single faction rules the South Seas. The Steamwheedle Cartel controls the main merchant traffic between Steamwheedle Port and Booty Bay, while rival pirate outfits such as the Bloodsail Buccaneers and the Southsea Freebooters contest the waters.

faq.q: What dangerous creatures live in these waters?
faq.answer: Giant squids, coastal reef sharks, and armored giant turtles threaten ships on the open waves. During the Second War, the Horde's Stormreaver clan captured giant turtles from these waters and refitted them as naval submersibles. The islands also shelter flesh-eating bloodwing bats and naga patrols.

faq.q: What notable islands lie out in the South Seas?
faq.answer: Tel'Abim, rich in fruit, and Zandalar, historic realm of the troll empire, lie in the deep waters. Yojamba Isle and Jaguero Isle sit closer to the coasts.

angles.text: The lawless South Seas sustain pirate cartels and privateers. They offer opportunities for scoundrels skilled in boarding ships, smuggling contraband, and navigating the politics of cutthroat harbors.
The South Seas and their shores yield ocean fish, giant squids, and sweet bananas shipped from isolated isles such as Tel'Abim.
